timeline.label: Agree budget, guest-list draft and priorities
Book venue and lock the date
Book caterer and schedule a tasting
Choose attire and book beauty trials
Chase RSVPs and fix final headcount
Finalise menu, seating plan and run of show
Reconfirm every vendor and payment schedule
Confirm weather backup for the outdoor setup
Hold rehearsal and share the day-of schedule
Pay final balances and prepare tip envelopes
Send thank-you notes and settle final invoices

vendors.name: Venue
tasks: Visit two or three shortlisted venues
Confirm capacity, parking and noise limits
Ask about in-house vendor rules
questions: What is the exact guest capacity?
Until what time can we use the space?
What is the payment schedule and cancellation policy?

vendors.name: Photographer & videographer
tasks: Review full wedding albums, not only highlights
List must-have shots and family groups
questions: How many photographers will attend?
When will we receive edited files?
What is your backup plan if something goes wrong on the day?

vendors.name: Caterer
tasks: Shortlist caterers and attend a tasting
Fix per-plate price and serving staff count
questions: Can you serve vegetarian, jain options with separate preparation?
What is included per plate?
How much food is prepared as a buffer?
What is the payment schedule and cancellation policy?

vendors.name: Officiant & rituals
tasks: Confirm the ceremony order and duration
Prepare the list of ritual items
questions: Which items should the family arrange?
How long will the ceremony take?

vendors.name: Attire & beauty
tasks: Book fittings and trials
Plan alterations time
questions: How long do alterations take?
What is the payment schedule and cancellation policy?

vendors.name: Decor & florist
tasks: Share a mood board and colour palette
Confirm set-up and tear-down times
questions: Which flowers are in season for our date?
What is your backup plan if something goes wrong on the day?
What is the payment schedule and cancellation policy?

vendors.name: Music, DJ or band
tasks: Share a must-play and do-not-play list
Check sound limits at the venue
questions: What equipment do you bring?
What is your backup plan if something goes wrong on the day?
What is the payment schedule and cancellation policy?

vendors.name: Guest travel & stay
tasks: Block hotel rooms or homestays
Arrange local transport and signage
questions: What is the room-block release date?
What is the payment schedule and cancellation policy?

vendors.name: Invitations & stationery
tasks: Finalise wording and languages
Proof every name and date
questions: What is the print turnaround?
Can you send a digital version too?

vendors.name: Tent, lighting & rentals
tasks: Get quotes for tent or canopy cover
Plan power and lighting
questions: Is wind and rain cover included?
Who sets up and who removes?

advisories.message: Only 151 days to go: lead times were shortened. Book the items marked critical first.
Outdoor setting: a weather backup is in the plan.
Large crowd: confirm the venue's licensed capacity, fire exits and first-aid cover.
